scope: Static comparison of build-ability-data.mjs and abilities-v1.json with all original compiled engine functions. No files except this audit were changed.
numeric_attack_values: All reviewed per-character damage, reach, half-width, speed, radius, lifetime, cooldown, ammo and duration values agree with source. Corrections below clarify conditions and invariant claims; they are not failed projectile snapshot probes.

corrections.observed: Values3 and5 are described as maximum_active. In source Y removes exactly ONE oldest seal if current count>=the current threshold, then adds one. X does not clear seals or shrink their count.
corrections.expected: Call these insertion replacement thresholds3/5 and record that existing seals survive expiry without immediate pruning. Starting with5 powered seals, natural expiry and a base-Q insertion can still leave5 seals.
corrections.suggested_probe: Create5 powered seals, expire form, insert one base seal; assert count remains5 and the oldest existing seal was replaced.

corrections.observed: A flat block>special>secondary>held_primary list can imply that an already queued special always dominates a later secondary edge.
corrections.expected: There is one queuedAction slot. The latest eligible rising edge overwrites that slot; special wins only when special and secondary rise in the same tick. Block clears the queue. On canAct, queued special/secondary are consumed before held primary.
corrections.suggested_probe: During an active attack, queue special then on a later tick raise secondary; assert queuedAction becomes secondary. In a single tick with both rising, assert special.

corrections.expected: dot(target_minus_player,action_direction)/max(1,distance)>=minimum_direction_dot, together with distance<=reach+target_radius. This matches normalisation for distance>=1 but is different at close overlap.

corrections.observed: require_designated_living_target_within_operator_distance190 and require_turret_within_operator_distance55 leave inclusive/exclusive comparison unspecified.
corrections.expected: Both comparisons are strictly less than190 and55, respectively; equality does not permit firing.

corrections.observed: The raw damage parameter is9, with shared vulnerability multiplier1.35 correctly declared elsewhere.
corrections.expected: State that Q sets vulnerableRemaining2.2 BEFORE B receives raw9, so a surviving ordinary target loses12.15 HP immediately. Do not label9 as observed HP loss.
corrections.suggested_probe: Place a500HP target inside the lantern arc, release Q and assert487.85HP plus vulnerability2.2.

corrections.observed: The copied constants key idleRecoveryPerSecond22 suggests recovery is restricted to idle.
corrections.expected: Recovery occurs whenever not blocking, guardRecovery<=epsilon and guardBroken<=epsilon, including ordinary attack actions. Rename to unblockedRecoveryPerSecond or add the exact eligibility condition.

corrections.observed: Defeat cleanup is listed but non-practice victory cleanup is absent.
corrections.expected: On victory, v directly sets specialRemaining0, clears projectiles/fields/turrets and vault, and returns to idle. It does not call X, so it does not emit Ashe natural-expiry finisher.

corrections.observed: Data preserves lifetime and spawn-forward9 but omits the original flightDuration and launchHeight capture.
corrections.expected: Record flight_duration_seconds=clamp((aim_distance-9)/speed,0.05,lifetime_seconds) and launch_height=player.vaultHeight at launch. These are original metadata; visual per-facing muzzle anchors remain separate.

corrections.observed: false is correct for the direct Q release handler, but could be read as preventing normal cooling during the action.
corrections.expected: Prefer direct_release_heat_change0. Ordinary cooling still runs during Q at15/sec, or7/sec powered; special caps existing heat at45.

confirmed_high_risk_rules: All14 base/powered timing helpers and release seconds are separate from drawing frame indices.
Velvet primed counter can survive form expiry; release consumes its own remaining timer.
Morel chain is finite, consumes patches once and can propagate beyond the initial155-unit selection when powered.
Brine out-of-range/dead/absent tether uses gun-butt fallback; projectile launch state controls later tether lifetime.
Pendle normal Q uses up to3 available rounds; powered Q is22-damage stock melee; special does not refill ammo.
Nix Q origin is action commitment; Mote has no autonomous persistent damaging orbit objects in this recovered source.
Iona recovered Q displacement is instant34 units, not a0.18s studio dash.
Ashe finisher is immediate on natural live expiry and uses current aim; interruption suppresses it.
Rook retains firing after Q release while airborne and has exactly2 designated-target turrets with per-turret cooldowns.
final_review_summary: All9 findings were corrected or clarified in the final builder/data. No additional numeric or semantic discrepancy found on reread; source presentation/world-unit decisions remain explicitly unresolved for the foundation owner.
